meta.title: Fluid Compute Billing: One Instance, Two Form Submissions

spans.name: Instance memory: 2 GB allocated
spans.detail: 2 GB × 0.5 s = 1 GB-second = 0.000278 GB-hours. Shared by every request on this instance.

spans.name: Request A: consultation form
spans.detail: Wall-clock duration 500 ms; only 30 ms of it uses the CPU.

spans.name: Request B: arrives while A waits
spans.detail: Runs on the same instance and memory instead of starting a new one.

cards.title: What is billed
items: Active CPU: 30 ms + 20 ms = 50 ms → 0.0000139 CPU-hours × $0.177

cards.title: What is not billed
items: CPU while waiting on Cloudflare and Zoho (440 ms + 340 ms)
Requests are not rounded up to an hour; usage accumulates
Request B adds no extra memory: it shares A's instance

cards.title: Read carefully
items: 1 vCPU / 2 GB is an allocation, not measured usage
Rates from planning; verify on Vercel's pricing page
